description:
FOUND + FIXED s473t1 (Opus, the 13-file early-stop triage).  PRE-EXISTING.

CAUSE.  `+EXPR` is perl's pure disambiguator and MEANS EXPR.  ExprToCL's
gen_prefix_op_form `+` arm already passed the operand through unchanged
(unwrapping a single-child tree_val on the way), but _elem_container_key --
the ONE reading of "which container, which key", shared by exists, delete and
pos -- INSPECTS the argument NODE.  It saw the prefix_op wrapper, was not an
accessor type, and returned (), so the caller fell through to the generic
one-argument lowering.

    exists  ($r//0)->[$i]{$k}[$j]{$c}   ->  (p-exists CONTAINER KEY)   correct
    exists +($r//0)->[$i]{$k}[$j]{$c}   ->  (p-exists VALUE)           arity crash

FIX (Pl/ExprToCL.pm).  One helper `_thru_unary_plus`, called at the head of
_elem_container_key: it repeats the emitter's own two steps in the emitter's
order (prefix_op '+' -> operand; a single-child tree_val -> its child), so the
node it hands back is exactly the one the `+` arm would have generated.  Three
consumers (exists / delete / pos) fixed at one point.

MEASURED.  perl-tests/multideref.t went PARTIAL 41+9/65 -> OK 53+10/65: the
crash aborted the file's single big top-level form at test 52, so 13 rows
never ran (`exists: general`, the six `delete: *`, the six `!exists: *`).
corpus-diff over the 111 perl-tests files: multideref.t the ONLY differing
file.  emission-ab over lib/**.pm (25), cpan-tests/**.pm (93) and perl's own
t/**.t (604): SAME everywhere except t/op/multideref.t, RCDIFF 0.

GUARD: Pl/t/delete-01.t rows 13-14 (12 -> 14), inverse-verified on a
`git archive 31473881` extraction (both FAIL there).
subject: DONE s473t1: `exists`/`delete`/`pos` did not see through a unary `+` -- `exists +($r//0)->[$i]{$k}` emitted a ONE-argument (p-exists VALUE) and died with a raw CL "invalid number of arguments: 1"
